changes.relayer: a swap's requests take turns and run to their end whether or not their clients still wait; each one-time step of a swap goes out once, a repeat answering 503 while the first may still land and 200 once it has, never 500; restarted, it sends none from an account whose earlier sends aren't mined
changes.gateway: quotes (2 a second, bursts of 30) and accepts (2 a second, bursts of 20, ten at a time) in zones of their own, where both shared 2 a second with bursts of 20
changes.maker: c1b865c's binary, byte for byte; not restarted
changes.issuer: 0d4cdb3's binary, byte for byte; not restarted

validation.newSite: nginx -t passed on the new site alone before anything changed, and in place before the reload
validation.quoteAndAccept: each reached the maker through its own zone: 422 for a quote it couldn't read, 401 with its token challenge for an accept
